debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

log_file.description: Path to log file; '-' for stdout/stderr; 'syslog' for syslog.

project_domain_name.description: Keystone project domain name for the placement service user.

project_name.description: Keystone project (tenant) name where the placement service user resides.

user_domain_name.description: Keystone user domain name for the placement service user.

service_username.description: Username of the Keystone service account for placement.

service_password.description: Password for the placement service user. *Required if using Keystone auth.*

api_endpoint.description: Public/internal endpoint URL where this placement API instance is reachable by other OpenStack services.

use_database.description: Enable database storage for inventory data (required for most deployments).

database_connection.description: Database connection string. Uses SQLAlchemy URI format.

use_api_database.description: Use a dedicated database for placement (overrides [database] section). Rarely needed.

api_database_connection.description: Dedicated API database connection string. Only used if use_api_database is true.

max_request_body_size.description: Maximum HTTP request body size in bytes (default ~112 KB). Increase for large resource provider updates.

policy_file.description: Path to the policy definition JSON file.

use_keystone_authtoken.description: Enable Keystone auth token middleware (typically used when placement is behind a proxy or with token-based middleware).

www_authenticate_uri.description: Public Keystone endpoint used for WWW-Authenticate header (required by middleware).

connection_recycle.description: Database connection recycle timeout in seconds (prevents stale connections).

max_overflow.description: Maximum overflow connections in the pool beyond pool_size.

pool_size.description: Number of persistent database connections in the pool.
